column1: # formats.tsv - the one format table (SF-0 Sections 2.2, 6 item 3).
# Every derived constant (masks, bias, emin, default quiet NaN, Pmin) is
# computed from these columns by tools/gen_tables.py; no per-format file
#   name    short token used in API names (msf16_t comes from f16 -> 16)
#   p       precision (significand bits incl. hidden bit)
#   pmin    decimal round-trip minimum digits (754-2019 5.12 via S1)
#   type    C bit-container type for the public API (SF-0 Section 3.3)
